description: Indicates when childcare is available on this day. Each property is independent: omitting a property clears any previously set value for it. Not applicable when the event has a term with id `K7mPx3nQrT9bWfH2zL5cYv` ("Kinderopvang"), because such an event is childcare itself. Changing the event type to that term removes any childcare times that were already set.

allOf.description: The time at which childcare becomes available on this day, in H:MM or HH:MM format (24-hour notation). Must be earlier than `opens`.
The time at which childcare ends on this day, in H:MM or HH:MM format (24-hour notation). Must be later than `closes`.
